recipes.title: Shape Detective
recipes.summary: Predict array compatibility, result shape, and memory before asking NumPy to execute the operation.
recipes.deliverable: A calculator that explains broadcast and matrix-product decisions axis by axis.
steps: Accept operand shapes, dtypes, and an operation without evaluating arbitrary code.
Right-align elementwise shapes and label each compatible, expanded, or conflicting axis.
Implement the separate (..., m, k) @ (..., k, n) rule for matrix multiplication.
Compute output elements and bytes from dtype item size.
Execute a generated safe NumPy case and compare the actual result with the prediction.
gates: Predicts scalar, vector, batch-bias, multi-axis broadcast, and incompatible cases.
Predicts matrix and batched matrix multiplication without trial transposes.
Exact output byte estimate equals ndarray.nbytes for fixtures.
Failure messages identify the first incompatible axis and link to the glossary.
extensions: Add activation and optimizer-state memory estimates.

recipes.title: Derivative Detective
recipes.summary: Compare local derivative rules, centered finite differences, and reverse-mode accumulation on the same expression.
recipes.deliverable: An expression graph that displays each node value, local rule, incoming sensitivity, and accumulated gradient.
steps: Implement a scalar node for add, multiply, power, exp, log, and ReLU.
Topologically order the graph and seed the scalar output gradient with one.
Accumulate every parent contribution rather than overwriting at graph joins.
Compute centered finite differences over a range of epsilon values.
Display relative error and explain truncation-versus-rounding behavior.
gates: Branched expressions such as x*x + x accumulate both paths.
Smooth-function relative gradient error is below 1e-6 in float64.
Invalid log-domain input yields a typed explanation instead of NaN propagation.
Repeated backward behavior is documented and tested.
extensions: Export a graph trace for the diagnostic viewer.

recipes.title: First Learner: Linear Regression
recipes.summary: Fit a known line from seeded synthetic data using equations and NumPy primitives.
recipes.deliverable: A reproducible trainer, loss chart, parameter-trajectory chart, and least-squares comparison report.
steps: Generate x and y = 3x + 2 + noise with an explicit Generator and seed.
Implement prediction and mean-squared error using array operations.
Derive and implement gradients for slope and intercept.
Train with gradient descent while recording configuration and metrics.
Compare fitted parameters to numpy.linalg.lstsq as an oracle.
gates: Analytical and centered finite-difference gradients agree below 1e-6 relative error.
Loss falls on the fixed dataset and fitted parameters meet declared tolerances.
A rerun under the recorded environment and seed reproduces the history.
Training statistics never inspect a held-out evaluation split.
extensions: Display confidence intervals from repeated seeded datasets.

recipes.title: XOR Ladder
recipes.summary: Use XOR to expose a single linear unit's limit, then build and diagnose a hidden-layer network.
recipes.deliverable: A deterministic XOR experiment with architecture, training, gradient health, and checkpoint panels.
steps: Train one linear unit and explain why it cannot separate XOR.
Add a hidden Linear-ReLU block and verify every forward shape.
Train with SGD, then implement and compare Adam from its equations.
Record loss, predictions, parameter norms, gradient norms, seed, and versions.
Save NPZ arrays plus validated JSON metadata and reload into a fresh model.
gates: The linear baseline failure is preserved as evidence, not hidden.
The fixed-seed multilayer model classifies all four XOR points.
All layer and loss gradients pass finite-difference checks below 1e-5.
Checkpoint arrays round-trip exactly with allow_pickle disabled.

recipes.title: Tiny Character Transformer
recipes.summary: Build one causal transformer block from array operations and the Daedalus autograd engine.
recipes.deliverable: A one-block character model with attention inspection, deterministic training, checkpointing, and generation.
steps: Create a character vocabulary and fixed-length next-token batches.
Implement embeddings, positional information, scaled dot-product attention, and a causal mask.
Add residual paths, normalization, feed-forward layers, and stable cross-entropy.
Overfit one small batch before attempting a larger local text sample.
Inspect attention row sums and masked probabilities, then generate from a fixed prompt.
gates: Attention probabilities are finite, each row sums to one, and future positions are zero.
Primitive and block gradients pass targeted finite-difference checks.
Fixed-corpus training loss falls by at least 50 percent from its initial value.
Locked environment, seed, input hash, and checkpoint reproduce the reference generation.
extensions: Profile naive attention memory against sequence length.

recipes.title: Push Guardian and Restore Drill
recipes.summary: Exercise publication and recovery controls against controlled clean and unsafe fixtures.
recipes.deliverable: A dry-run release report and a hash-verified restore into a new location.
steps: Create fixture repositories for clean content, a fake secret, an ignored untracked file, an ignored tracked file, and a push conflict.
Inspect the exact outgoing commit range and redact report evidence.
Join lockfile findings with available local audit and authenticated Dependabot alert data without claiming unavailable data.
Back up source and private workspace to a marked destination without deleting destination-only files.
Corrupt the working fixture, restore into a new path, and compare file hashes.
gates: Unsafe fixtures block and the clean fixture passes with deterministic reasons.
No report contains the fake secret value or private absolute paths.
The tool never force-pushes, silently rewrites dependencies, or publishes user workspaces.
Restore never overwrites the active workspace and all expected hashes match.
extensions: Add a GitHub Actions parity check.
Attach an SBOM and artifact checksum to a test release.
